results.change: What kind of change is this?
results.changeNone: Not stated (the system works it out)
results.changeHint: Only when this result replaces another. An amendment is a new measurement; a correction means the earlier value was wrong and starts a review.

readiness.title: Visit readiness
readiness.note: There is no list of visits here: enter the visit id. The questions and checklist belong to the clinic and are not shown, only where the run is.
readiness.visitIdBad: That is not a visit id.
readiness.noRun: There is no readiness run for this visit yet.
readiness.startBody: Starts the run for this visit, or shows the one already running. Starting twice returns the same run.
readiness.relayBody: Enter what the patient said, or record that no reply came. The rules read the reply first, and it is stored encrypted.
readiness.notWaiting: This run is not waiting for a reply. Nothing was recorded.
readiness.replyNeedsText: A reply needs text. Nothing was recorded.
readiness.noContent: This kind of visit has no readiness content set up. Nothing was started.
readiness.notConfigured: Visit readiness is not set up yet. Nothing was written.

claims.title: Portal claims
claims.note: Pending requests from people who registered on the portal to be linked to a record. The list shows only a request id and a time. Decide from what the person told you in person, and approve onto the confirmed record.
claims.approveBody: Links the person to the confirmed record you choose. It is recorded under your name.
claims.rejectBody: Rejects the request. Nobody is linked. It is recorded under your name.
claims.needsPatient: Choose the confirmed record to approve onto. Nothing was recorded.

result.approved: Approved. The person is linked to the record.
result.record_not_claimable: That record cannot be claimed. Nothing was linked.
result.claimant_already_bound: This person is already linked to a record. Nothing was changed.
result.consent_required: The person has not given the required consent yet. Nothing was linked.

access.title: Break-glass access
access.note: Read one patient's messages for a limited time, with a reason code. Every read is recorded, and an administrator who did not open the access reviews it afterwards. There is no free text.
access.open: Open access to a patient's messages
access.openBody: Opens a time-limited grant for ONE patient. Every read is recorded under your name and reviewed afterwards.
access.reasonHint: A code from the clinic's list (lowercase letters, digits and underscores). The backend refuses a code that is not on the list.
access.reasonRefused: That reason code is not on the clinic's list. Nothing was opened.
access.notConfigured: Break-glass access is not set up yet (the window length is not configured). Nothing was opened.
access.patientNotFound: The patient was not found. Nothing was opened.
access.windowClosed: The access window has closed, or this access is not yours.
access.keysMissing: Encryption keys are not configured, so the messages cannot be read.
access.reviewNote: Grants that have not been reviewed. You cannot review an access you opened yourself.
access.noGrants: There are no grants to review.
access.reviewBody: Records your review of this access, under your name. It cannot be changed afterwards.

reviewResult.same_person: You opened this access, so someone else must review it.

notes.title: Notes
notes.note: Notes are never edited. A correction is an addendum: a new note that names the one it adds to.
notes.empty: There are no notes for this patient.
notes.writeBody: Writes a new note for this patient. It cannot be edited afterwards.
notes.addendBody: Writes a new note that adds to the earlier one. The earlier note is not changed.
notes.keysMissing: Encryption keys are not configured. Nothing was written.
notes.notFound: The patient or the note was not found. Nothing was written.

recovery.note: Resets a staff member's second factor. You cannot ask for your own, and a second administrator, who is neither the requester nor the person being recovered, must approve it.
recovery.requestBody: Asks for this account's second factor to be reset. Nothing is reset until a second administrator approves and it is completed.
recovery.approveBody: Approves the request as the second administrator. The second factor is not reset until it is completed.
recovery.completeBody: Resets the account's second factor now. The person sets up a new one at their next sign-in.
recovery.cancelBody: Cancels the request. Nothing is reset.
recovery.refused: You cannot do this: you may be the requester or the person being recovered, or you are not an administrator of this clinic.
recovery.cannotRequest: A recovery cannot be requested for this account: it is your own, it is not staff of this clinic, or one is already open.
recovery.notConfigured: Recovery is not set up yet (no sign-in administration is configured). Nothing was reset.

result.approved: Approved. It still has to be completed.
result.completed: Completed. The second factor was reset.

grievances.note: Grievances sent by patients. The text is shown as the patient wrote it while it can be read. A resolved grievance is final.
grievances.acknowledgeBody: Records that you have seen it, under your name.
grievances.resolveBody: Closes the grievance, under your name. A resolved grievance is final.

result.invalid_transition: That change is not allowed from its current status. Nothing was changed.
